sections.title: Learn More About Our Cybersecurity Services

items.question: What are Victrix's cybersecurity offerings?
items.answer: Cybersecurity is part of Victrix's DNA. We support organizations through strategic, value-added guidance. Our cybersecurity services include penetration testing (Pentest), GRC audit (risk and compliance management), business continuity and recovery plans (BCP/BRP), implementation of the Zero Trust model, compliance with Law 25, GDPR, DORA, and other personal data protection standards, IoT security and inventory assessment, and identity management and access control with the SASE model.

items.question: What does Victrix do to ensure operational security?
items.answer: Victrix supports public and private sector cybersecurity efforts through security posture and maturity assessments, deployment of controls (EDR-XDR-MDR), identity and access management (IDaaS), and operational management, including cybersecurity audits and 24/7 managed services.

items.question: Can Victrix help my organization secure its cloud?
items.answer: Victrix is your strategic partner for cloud cybersecurity services such as secure infrastructure deployment (PaaS, SaaS, and IaaS), application transformation and optimization (DevOps/DevSecOps), API protection, and process automation.
